name: Schedule three commitments
short_description: Place three commitments and their travel or preparation buffers into a conflict-free day plan.
self_assessment: I can schedule three commitments with required buffers without help or a time conflict.
description: Place three commitments and their travel or preparation buffers into a conflict-free day plan. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Arrange three appointments in one day
